# SPD-051 — Bash hook: program-naming options on other allowed git verbs (send-email --sendmail-cmd, instaweb --httpd, web--browse, help viewer)

## Brief
SPD-046 covers program-naming options on ls-remote/fetch (--upload-pack), grep (-O/--open-files-in-pager), difftool (-x/--extcmd) and archive (--exec), the five verbs the brief enumerated and I probed. The same class exists on a few other verbs Law 7 allows: git send-email --sendmail-cmd=<cmd> / --smtp-server=<cmd path> / --to-cmd / --cc-cmd run a program; git instaweb --httpd=<cmd> and instaweb.httpd start one; git web--browse and git help via man.<viewer>.cmd / GIT_MAN_VIEWER run a viewer. The config forms are already refused by SPD-046's allowlist (sendemail.*, instaweb.*, man.* are non-allowlisted keys), so only the command-line OPTION forms of these verbs are uncovered. They are niche (send-email and instaweb are optional git subcommands often not installed), which is why I left them out rather than adding unprobed option names against the brief's evidence-first rule.

Evidence: GIT_VERB_PROGRAM_OPTIONS in bin/spud_ledger.py lists only ls-remote/fetch/grep/difftool/archive. git help --config shows sendemail.*, instaweb.httpd, man.<tool>.cmd as program keys (refused by the config allowlist); the matching CLI options are not in the table. Not probed here (would need git-email/instaweb installed). Also two minor edges in the same code: a clustered short option like grep -nO is not caught (only -O and -O<pager> are), and a glob expanding to one of the new verbs/options is not in GLOB_SAMPLES.
